name: Hamiel Luís
source:
A con man with the air of a playboy. Although he's good with people and excels at manipulating their minds with his eloquent words, his sarcasm and sharp tongue often bleed into his speech.

Due to his strong self-assertion, he often gets himself into trouble with other people. He also excels at disguising himself and cheating when gambling.

Hometown: Blanes [Spain]
